summary: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that Qiu Wenjuan resigned as Director and Vice President effective September 29, 2026, with no disagreement cited, and the Board immediately appointed Shang-Yu Li, aged 30, as Director and Vice President. The filing discloses no transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock; it is a routine board succession disclosure rather than a special situation. Watch for any subsequent 6-K disclosing strategic initiatives, capital events, or further governance turnover.
